tree.heading: Federal Charter.—
tree.text: The Help America Vote Foundation (in this chapter, the “foundation”) is a federally chartered corporation.

tree.heading: Nature of Foundation.—
tree.text: The foundation is a charitable and nonprofit corporation and is not an agency or establishment of the United States Government.

tree.heading: Perpetual Existence.—
tree.text: Except as otherwise provided, the foundation has perpetual existence.

notes.text: Amendments2014—Pub. L. 113–237 renumbered section 152601 of this title as this section.
